configuration.description: Back up your preferences or transfer selected categories to another computer. Audio files, playlists and queues are managed separately.
configuration.exportDescription: Choose the categories to include in the backup.
configuration.importDescription: Open a Song Player backup and review the changes before applying them.
configuration.reviewDescription: Only selected categories will be applied. Expand a category to compare current and imported values.
configuration.undoDescription: Your previous configuration is backed up automatically before an import. It remains available to restore after restarting the app.
configuration.importedSuccess: Selected settings imported. You can restore your previous configuration.
configuration.invalidFile: This file is not a supported Song Player settings backup or contains invalid values.
configuration.failed: The action could not be completed. Check the file and selected settings.
configuration.deviceHint: Output devices and global shortcuts may differ between computers. Include only when needed.
configuration.libraryHint: Transfers folder paths. Imported paths are added to the existing folder list.
